question: Which of the following alcohols is used in cough syrups?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethanol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ethanol**, also known as ethyl alcohol, is commonly used as a solvent in the pharmaceutical industry.
 
• It is a key ingredient in cough syrups and other liquid medications due to its effectiveness in dissolving various substances.
 
• Ethanol acts as a preservative and helps to prevent microbial growth in medicinal formulations.
 
• It provides a consistent delivery of the medication by maintaining the stability and homogeneity of the active ingredients.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ethanol**:

 
 
• It is a clear, colorless liquid with a characteristic alcoholic odor.
 
• Ethanol is also used in the manufacture of perfumes, paints, and tinctures.
 
• It is a potent central nervous system depressant and is the type of alcohol found in alcoholic beverages.
 
 
 
• **Methanol**:
 
 
• It is a toxic alcohol that can cause serious health issues, including blindness and death if ingested.
 
• Methanol is primarily used in industrial applications and as an antifreeze, solvent, and fuel.
 
 
 
• **Ethanoic acid**:
 
 
• Also known as acetic acid, it is the main component of vinegar.
 
• It is used as a preservative and flavoring agent in the food industry.
 
 
 
• **Propanol**:
 
 
• It refers to two types of alcohols: 1-propanol and 2-propanol (isopropanol).
 
• Isopropanol is commonly used as a disinfectant and cleaning agent.
